proof:
Source. Selected-node proof (root.chart_tangent_differential-a1.chart_blowup_tangent-a1), steps 1 and 2: the derivative of a map that is Lipschitz, resp. satisfies a lower Lipschitz bound, on an open set (the facts about the C¹ charts used in Simon's proof of Theorem 1.6 '⇒', chapter-03.txt lines 113-143, and Remark 1.5(2)). No sign assumption on c is needed.

Notation. ℝⁿ = Rn n with the Euclidean norm; Dψ(v) := fderiv ℝ ψ v : ℝⁿ →L[ℝ] ℝᴺ with its operator norm ‖·‖.

1. Differentiability. Fix v ∈ B and put D := Dψ(v). Since B is open and v ∈ B, B is a neighbourhood of v (IsOpen.mem_nhds). Since ψ is C¹ on B, it is differentiable on B (ContDiffOn.differentiableOn, as 1 ≠ 0), hence differentiable at v because B ∈ 𝓝 v (DifferentiableOn.differentiableAt); so ψ has Fréchet derivative D at v (DifferentiableAt.hasFDerivAt).

2. Upper bound. ψ is K-Lipschitz on the neighbourhood B of v, hence ‖D‖ ≤ K (Mathlib norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitzOn with s = B ∈ 𝓝 v). (Underlying argument: for w ∈ ℝⁿ and small t > 0, v + t w ∈ B and |ψ(v + t w) − ψ(v)| ≤ K t |w|; dividing by t and letting t ↓ 0 gives |D w| ≤ K |w| for every w, i.e. ‖D‖ ≤ K.)

3. Lower bound, admissible t. Fix w ∈ ℝⁿ. The map t ↦ v + t•w is continuous with value v at t = 0, so v + t•w → v as t → 0⁺ (filter 𝓝[>]0); since B ∈ 𝓝 v, eventually in 𝓝[>]0 we have v + t•w ∈ B, and also t > 0 (self_mem_nhdsWithin).

4. For every such t (t > 0 and v + t•w ∈ B), the hypothesis applied to u = v + t•w and u' = v gives c·|t•w| ≤ |ψ(v + t•w) − ψ(v)|, i.e. c·t·|w| ≤ |ψ(v + t•w) − ψ(v)|. Multiplying by t⁻¹ > 0: c|w| = t⁻¹·(c·(t·|w|)) ≤ t⁻¹·|ψ(v + t•w) − ψ(v)| = |t⁻¹•(ψ(v + t•w) − ψ(v))|.

5. Limit of the difference quotients. As t → 0⁺ we have |t⁻¹| = t⁻¹ → +∞ (tendsto_inv_nhdsGT_zero). Hence the derivative of ψ at v (HasFDerivAt.lim, applied with direction w and the scalars c(t) = t⁻¹, for which (c(t))⁻¹ = t) gives t⁻¹•(ψ(v + t•w) − ψ(v)) → D w as t → 0⁺, and by continuity of the norm |t⁻¹•(ψ(v + t•w) − ψ(v))| → |D w|.

6. Conclusion. By step 4 the quantities converging in step 5 are eventually ≥ c|w|, so the limit satisfies c|w| ≤ |D w| (ge_of_tendsto). Since v ∈ B and w ∈ ℝⁿ were arbitrary, steps 2 and 6 give ‖Dψ(v)‖ ≤ K and c|w| ≤ |Dψ(v) w| for all v ∈ B and w ∈ ℝⁿ. ∎

```lean
import GMT.Ch03.Submission
open Filter MeasureTheory Module Set
open scoped CompactlySupported ENNReal NNReal Topology
namespace GMT.Ch03
open Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03 (CountablyRectifiable HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt PurelyUnrectifiable blowUpMap)

theorem Submission.chartTD_chart_fderiv_bounds : (∀ (n N : ℕ) (B : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (K : ℝ≥0) (c : ℝ), IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ B → LipschitzOnWith K ψ B → (∀ u ∈ B, ∀ u' ∈ B, c * ‖u - u'‖ ≤ ‖ψ u - ψ u'‖) → ∀ v ∈ B, ‖fderiv ℝ ψ v‖ ≤ K ∧ ∀ w : Rn n, c * ‖w‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ ψ v w‖) := by
  intro n N B ψ K c hB hψ hLip hlow v hv
  have hBv : B ∈ 𝓝 v := hB.mem_nhds hv
  refine ⟨norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitzOn ℝ hBv hLip, fun w => ?_⟩
  have hd : HasFDerivAt ψ (fderiv ℝ ψ v) v :=
    ((hψ.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt hBv).hasFDerivAt
  have hlim := hd.lim w (c := fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹) (l := 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ)) (by
    refine (tendsto_inv_nhdsGT_zero (𝕜 := ℝ)).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
    simp [abs_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < t from ht)])
  have hnorm := (continuous_norm.tendsto _).comp hlim
  refine ge_of_tendsto hnorm ?_
  have hev : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ), v + t • w ∈ B := by
    have : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => v + t • w) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v) := by
      have : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => v + t • w) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (v + (0:ℝ) • w)) :=
        ((continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)).tendsto 0)
      simpa using this.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    exact this hBv
  filter_upwards [hev, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht htpos
  simp only [Function.comp, inv_inv]
  have h1 := hlow (v + t • w) ht v hv
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt htpos)] at h1
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt htpos))]
  have htpos' : (0:ℝ) < t := htpos
  calc c * ‖w‖ = t⁻¹ * (c * (t * ‖w‖)) := by field_simp
    _ ≤ t⁻¹ * ‖ψ (v + t • w) - ψ v‖ := by gcongr

end GMT.Ch03
```

For small t > 0, v + t•w ∈ B and c·t|w| ≤ |ψ(v + t•w) − ψ(v)|, so c|w| ≤ |t⁻¹•(ψ(v + t•w) − ψ(v))|.
The difference quotients converge to D w as t → 0⁺ (HasFDerivAt.lim); passing to the limit gives c|w| ≤ |D w| (ge_of_tendsto).
